summary: @brick-v2/brand exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials via native addon on require()
details: The package's main entry index.js loads a bundled native addon at prebuilds/linux-x64/metrics.node on require(). The native binary reads a broad set of installer secrets — AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN — along with hostname, username, cwd, and uname output, and transmits them via a raw socket POST to the hardcoded host oob.s4yhii.com (string 'POST /native HTTP/1.0' present in the binary). The native module also imports fork and setsid from libc, consistent with detaching into a background process after collection so activity continues beyond the require() call. Package shape matches dependency-confusion overshadow: scoped name @brick-v2/brand published publicly at an abnormally high version 999.0.1 with a trivial JS stub whose only real behavior is loading the opaque native payload — designed to win resolution against a private internal package of the same scope and name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
